To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

The marketing communications mix can be conceptualized as a four-dimensional space, which we call the Marketing Communication Tetrad (i.e. a tetrahedron with vertices labeled consumer, communication, situation and response) that provides a framework to classify and analyze factors influencing the effectiveness of a marketing communication program.

the marketing communication tetrahedron is a useful tool for analyzing and evaluating integrated marketing communications (IMC) programs and that IMC programs are most effective when they provide coverage, contribute to the marketing objectives, and are common, complementary, robust and cost efficient.
Marketing communication effectiveness is influenced by a variety of factors related to the target audience, marketing communication, the consumer response, and the communication situation.
In summary, our research is concerned with

understanding the marketing communication mix, the factors affecting its effectiveness, and how these factors should be considered in the design and evaluation of integrated marketing communication programs.
how marketing communication programs can effectively and efficiently achieve marketing goals and objectives, and how they can be designed, implemented, and evaluated.
how to develop, execute, and evaluate integrated marketing communication programs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the marketing communications mix is the sum of the individual marketing communication tools that are available to a marketer and that are used in an integrated marketing communications program to achieve the marketing communications objectives of an organization.

the marketing communication tetrahedron is a useful framework to understand and analyze factors influencing the effectiveness of marketing communications, whereas the integrated marketing communication program criteria are useful for designing and evaluating marketing communications programs.
the integrated marketing communication (IMC) concept is a useful tool for marketers to achieve the most efficient use of their marketing communications budget.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
integrated marketing communication programs should be designed and evaluated along both micro and macro dimensions.
integrated marketing communication programs are a powerful means of communicating with and influencing consumers.

the Marketing Communication Tetrahedron can provide a framework for developing a more comprehensive understanding of the factors influencing marketing communication programs and the criteria for evaluating integrated marketing communication programs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
marketers should not think of marketing communications as separate activities but instead as an integrated whole.
the integrated marketing communication literature has been dominated by micro perspectives that have focused on individual marketing communication options.
marketers must understand how to combine various marketing communication options to create effective, efficient, and integrated communication programs.
